name: Reputation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the value of a good reputation, presenting it as more desirable than great riches or precious ointment, highlighting its lasting worth beyond material wealth. Proverbs and Ecclesiastes both affirm that a good name and loving favor hold greater significance than silver, gold, or even the day of one's birth. Additionally, Philippians reveals the humility of Christ, who willingly made himself of no reputation to serve humanity, showing that true greatness often involves selflessness rather than seeking honor.
